settings.heading: What a home sauna costs to install
settings.intro_fact: We do not publish an installation cost. Not a range, not an average, not a default — the $1,800 tier is InHouse's delivery and assembly, and the electrician is a separate, third-party bill. Enter your own quote and it goes straight into the five-year total below.
settings.collection_label: Every sauna, with the circuit each one states
settings.dataset_name: InHouse Wellness home sauna cost tables
settings.dataset_description: Purchase price, delivery tier, rated power and state electricity rate for 139 priced home saunas, each figure carrying its source and fetch date. Rated power is present for 47; the remaining 92 are recorded as absent rather than estimated.
